description: This file defines the LogHelper utility class for logging purposes, providing methods to create log tags and log messages at various levels, with build configuration-based controls.

classes.name: LogHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for flexible and conditional logging in Android applications.

methods.name: makeLogTag
methods.description: Creates a log tag string with a preset prefix, truncating if necessary to fit maximum length.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message if the build configuration is set to DEBUG.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message if the build configuration is set to DEBUG.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with an accompanying throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with an accompanying throwable.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Performs the actual logging based on level, message content, and build configuration.
